svg.title: NOON fringes versus classical two-photon exposure
svg.desc: Three curves over two classical fringe periods: the one-photon classical fringe (raised cosine, period one), the classical two-photon exposure I squared with the same period but narrower peaks, and the ideal N = 2 NOON pattern whose period is halved.
